## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 28, 2026 - Aug 14, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _plantguyhome_, May 28, 2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            2. _I hate. Finch_, Jul 9, 2026, 2/5: "Finch is bad because it I so slow"
            3. _Scoutie McScoutington_, Aug 14, 2026, 3/5: "i've only had the app for about a year and a half, and in that time, i feel like the self~care options have been overshadowed by weird, random things which seem to get added and then removed monthly or even weekly, but i haven't noticed any additions or improvements to managing tasks or self~care. the app is also startlingly slow recently, and in the past five or six months, it has been crashing randomly or even losing my data—luckily i make back~ups twice a day, or my birb would've disappeared into the ether. 😢 i absolutely adored this app, and i sincerely want to again. i'm a pro user, and i intend (for the time being) to stay at that level of supporting the app. but devs: please please remember the people who downloaded *this* app because of how helpful it was for those of us with disabilities of one sort and / or another. yes, i love my birb friend and i want to dress them up & have fun, but i don't have time for that when i can't get through my daily tasks easily because they keep being rearranged on me…i can't have silly birb fun when i need support resources but can't find them easily while having a meltdown…and above all, i can't can't can't deal w/ near constant changes to something which i got to help me find balance. 😢"
<!--/ir-theme-->
